name: People
notes: A thread's or a client's People tab and person panel

features.feature: People shows Map, Org chart or List (remembered), the stance legend and + Person (on a thread)
The Map places people and organisations by influence × interest in four quadrants, the rest in "Not placed yet"; dragging one to a quadrant sets it
With nobody in the thread it says so and offers the people seen in its calls
The List shows each person's name, new / quiet tags, side (your company, their organisation, their domain) and role (threads, on a client)

A person's panel shows who they are (Echo's summary or the user's), their place in the thread (role, stance, influence, interest, workstream, governance, works for), details (title, organisation, group, reports to, matters, phone), what Echo saw, facts, often with, changes; each value is edited in place
Suggestions from the sync's people pass ("Is Dana a champion?", with the quote) are answered Yes / No / Change…; three show, "N more"
"Same person as…" merges two people, a suggested match is answered, and a merge can be split; an unknown domain offers "Name this organisation"

Colleagues' photos in place of initials (call rows, the people map with the stance as a ring, a work item's people, Today's meeting faces, people menus): only with the switch on and a sign-in that may read photos (else nothing is asked), only people in the user's own mail domain found in the people directory (others keep initials); one without a photo keeps initials, asked again after a week; kept on this computer, 96 px
